prioritySemanticConclusion: Priority currently behaves as preference, not guarantee. It is applied in ordering, but timing and duplicate checks can override it.

optionA.title: Keep current logic
pros: Deterministic behavior confirmed across identical reruns
Strong operating-hours safety; avoids invalid visit windows
cons: Priority-1 can still be deferred/rejected by timing and duplicate controls
Client perception issue when raw logs show both selected and rejected attempts
optionA.expectedItineraryImpact: Stable outcomes; no change in hotspot mix patterns.
likelyCodeAreas: Only reporting and communication around existing decision flow

optionB.title: Priority-1 guaranteed if route-matched
pros: Clear business guarantee for client-facing premium hotspots
cons: May violate operating windows or force schedule compression unless compensating rules added
Could increase conflicts and forced reshuffling of lower priorities
optionB.expectedItineraryImpact: More priority-1 inclusions; potential rise in downstream timing conflicts.
likelyCodeAreas: Hotspot sorting and defer/retry path in timeline builder
Operating-hours conflict handling and day-window gating

optionC.title: Priority-aware but time-adjusted scheduling
pros: Preserves timing validity while favoring high priorities
Balanced business behavior with fewer hard conflicts
cons: Needs careful regression verification on all route types
optionC.expectedItineraryImpact: Higher priority retention with controlled defer/shift behavior.
likelyCodeAreas: Deferred retry ordering and pass logic
Travel+visit slot fitting and window adjustments in timeline builder
